description: Scored static review (0-100) of the three.js code, pinned to the installed release: removed or renamed APIs, symbols that do not exist, code that renders nothing (no lights, shadows off, renderer not attached, never rendered), per-frame allocations, resize and dispose, colour management. One line per finding, `file:line severity [rule] message Fix: ...`, and the same as JSON. `code` + `file` reviews code before you save it. `only_new: true` in a fix loop: new findings in full, the ones you saw as a short line, and how many are fixed. `files` lists only findings in those files. Run it after every change and fix the errors first. It writes only its memory for only_new (.threesmith/review-last.json).

code.description: unsaved source to review in place of `file` on disk

detail.description: brief (capped, short) or full (everything); default brief

file.description: path (relative to path) that `code` belongs to; required with code

files.description: only show findings in these files (relative paths)

only_new.description: show only what changed since the last review (saves tokens in a fix loop)

path.description: Project folder, or a file or folder in it (relative to the server's folder; default: the project).

three.description: Path to a three package folder, when it is not in node_modules above the project.

name: three_review
title: Review three.js code
